summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" format entry and a Control.title(title) classmethod with docstring; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor (writes Control.title when is_terminal, returns True/False, no Windows calls); rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gains an Unreleased "Added" bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (skipped on win32), and test_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only, mocked, expects "Hello, world!"). Not run: tests, Black formatting were not executed per instructions; formatting was checked by hand. Nothing committed.
